definitions.explanation: A natural elevation of land that is lower and more gently sloped than a mountain. Often used in geographical and descriptive contexts.

examples.japanese: なだらかな{丘陵|きゅうりょう}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Gentle hills spread out before us.

examples.japanese: この{丘陵|きゅうりょう}{地帯|ちたい}にはブドウ{畑|ばたけ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many vineyards in this hilly area.

examples.japanese: {住宅地|じゅうたくち}は{丘陵|きゅうりょう}を{切|き}り{開|ひら}いて{造|つく}られた。
examples.english: The residential area was created by clearing the hills.

notes:
A geographical term more formal than {丘|おか} (hill). Used in geography, real estate, and descriptive writing. Japan has many {丘陵|きゅうりょう}{地帯|ちたい} (hilly areas), and the term appears frequently in place names and urban development descriptions.

FORMS:
{丘|きゅう} (hill) + {陵|りょう} (mound, hill)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}{地帯|ちたい}: hilly area, hill country
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}を{切|き}り{開|ひら}く: to clear/develop hills
- なだらかな{丘陵|きゅうりょう}: gentle hills
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}{地|ち}: hilly land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丘|おか}: hill — everyday word, smaller and more specific than {丘陵|きゅうりょう}
- {山|やま}: mountain — taller and steeper
- {台地|だいち}: plateau, tableland — elevated but flat on top
